name: SNAIL parametric oscillator (three-wave mixing, small Kerr)
question: Does raising the SNAIL pump through the parametric threshold write a phase chosen by a weak tone, and with which law?
assumptions: H_eff = -Delta b^dag b + g (b^2 + b^dag2) + (K/2) b^dag2 b^2 (Sivak 2019 eq. 2), kappa = 1, Kerr near the Kerr-free point K = 0.01
